label: Simplified ITB rules for demo
counting_note: A certification counts if its status is verified, declared or pending_training. pending_training is only created by funding a training package.

filters.description: The shop offers every one of the job's process_tags.
The job fits the shop's work envelope: the job's sorted dimensions are each <= the shop's sorted max_envelope_mm.
Every certification in the job's required_certs (other than CPCSC_L1, which the cpcsc filter checks) has a counting status at the shop.
A controlled job (controlled: true; technical data is a controlled good) may only go to a shop whose CGP registration counts. Muster never stores drawings.
If CPCSC_L1 is in the job's required_certs, the shop's CPCSC_L1 must count (self-assessed, shop-declared).
The shop's remaining weekly capacity (capacity_hours_week minus hours_week of jobs already assigned to it) is >= the job's hours_week.

eligible_definition: A shop is eligible for a job when it passes all six filters.
near_miss_definition: A near-miss shop fails only the certs filter (on one trainable cert) or only the capacity filter; training packages are built for near misses.
